privateDeals.what: Tether (via TPM) agreed in Feb 4, 2026 PIPE to buy 3,370,787 Gold.com shares at $44.50 (~$150M) in two tranches; first tranche $126.4M closed Feb 6, 2026
Tether bought 100,000 more Gold.com shares at ~$39.30 on open market
Tether swapped Northern Data AG shares for RUM Group shares under Transaction Support Agreement
Tether Investments tender offer for Adecoagro at $12.41/share to reach ~70% (67.1M shares tendered vs 49.6M max; ~73.9% proration)
Tether took 103,333,333 Rumble Class A shares (initial Form 3, event date)
Tether and Fasanara Capital launched $400M private credit fund (StableFund)
Tether reportedly in talks to raise $15-20B for ~3% stake, implying ~$500B valuation (Reuters, via Wikipedia summary)

policy.what: CFTC fined Tether $41M (and Bitfinex $1.5M) for false claims that USDT was fully backed by fiat reserves
New York AG settlement: iFinex/Bitfinex and Tether paid $18.5M over concealed ~$850M loss and reserve misstatements; barred from NY trading, required reserve disclosures (Feb 2021)
Tether moved official headquarters from BVI to San Salvador, El Salvador (announced Jan 2025)
Tether developing US-domiciled regulated stablecoin USAT (disclosed Aug 2025)
DOJ credited Tether's assistance in a $52M enforcement action against a scam network
